reviews.comment: All 6 checklist items pass; macOS native recursive watch + 100ms debounce verified live (1 touch → 1 frame, 5-touch burst → 1 frame). Non-blocking notes: no automated watcher test, no error listener on watchers, refreshSubdirs runs on every root event. Linux fallback ships untested on linux but gated by process.platform.

Mobile Safari shows yellow (reconnecting) live-dot; mutations do not repaint. Two blockers: (1) no WS keep-alive ping, Safari kills idle WS; (2) ws.onopen does not refetch state on reconnect. Verify same on desktop.

fix.comment: Swapped hand-rolled WS for Socket.IO. Auto-fallback to long-polling when WS upgrade is rejected by browsers, built-in heartbeat (25s) + reconnect, refetch-on-reconnect via hasSyncedOnce flag. Verified live in Chrome + mobile Safari.

reviews.comment: Socket.IO swap closes all 4 round-2 blockers at once (browser handshake, refetch-on-reconnect via hasSyncedOnce, 25s heartbeat, clean teardown). Verified live in desktop Chrome + mobile Safari. Watcher / debounce / SIGINT preserved. Non-blocking notes: lost comments in rewrite, no integration test, +1 published dependency.
